prompt.text:
Implement `buildConversionView(input)` and export it directly with `module.exports`. `input` must be a non-array object with `estimatedRate`, `amount`, `source`, `target`, and `direction`. `estimatedRate` and `amount` may be finite numbers or canonical decimal strings matching `^(0|[1-9]\d*)(\.\d+)?$`; symbols must be non-empty strings after trimming; direction must be `'forward'` or `'reverse'`. If `estimatedRate` is `null`, `undefined`, or `''`, or if the parsed amount is zero, return `null` after validating the other structural fields. Otherwise the rate and amount must be positive and finite; malformed, negative, zero-rate, or overflow values throw `TypeError`. Forward direction means one source equals `estimatedRate` target units. Reverse means one target equals `1 / estimatedRate` source units. Format the displayed rate by applying `toPrecision(7)`, converting the result back to a number, then to a string. Return `{ left, right, rate, text, nextDirection }`, where symbols are trimmed, `text` is `'1 <left> = <rate> <right>'`, and `nextDirection` is the opposite direction. Do not mutate or retain `input`.

Return only the complete source file; do not include Markdown fences or prose.
